goal: When the runner archives a done project, its README stays on main as `docs/project/<programme>/closeout/<name>.md`, beside the closeout record.

No relative Markdown link under `docs/project/` or `docs/technical/` is left pointing into a directory the archive removed: in the same commit it points at `closeout/<name>.md` or `closeout/<name>.json`.

success_criteria.criterion: `rewriteArchivedLinks` rewrites a README link (anchor kept), a directory link, a `PLAN.json` link and a link to another removed file to the right closeout path, relative to the file it is in, and leaves kept files, other links and fenced code alone.
success_criteria.check: `node --test --import ./tests/_isolate-home.mjs tests/mc/archive-plan.test.js` passes, including the tests named in step 1.

success_criteria.criterion: Archiving against real git leaves `docs/project/mc/closeout/documented.md` on main with the README's text, and a document on main that linked to `../mc/documented/README.md#close` and `../mc/documented/PLAN.json` links to `../mc/closeout/documented.md#close` and `../mc/closeout/documented.json`, all in the archive's one commit.
success_criteria.check: `node --test --import ./tests/_isolate-home.mjs tests/mc/archive-live.test.js tests/mc/run.test.js` passes, including the assertions named in step 2.

steps.title: A link into an archived directory, rewritten to its closeout
steps.done_when: `closeoutReadmePath` and `rewriteArchivedLinks` are exported, the new tests in `tests/mc/archive-plan.test.js` and `tests/mc/closeout.test.js` pass, and `mc gate` is green.
comments: rewriteArchivedLinks(text, { from, to, archived }) and closeoutReadmePath(programme, project) are exported (src/mc/archive-plan.js, src/mc/closeout.js). Nothing calls them yet: step 2 wires them into archiveIn. A directory link that holds a kept file is left alone, beyond the spec: the directory is still there after the archive, so pointing it at the closeout would break it. Fenced code is skipped; inline code spans are not special-cased. Gate green on this tree: 2742 tests, 0 failed, 9 skipped.

steps.title: The archive moves the README and rewrites the links in its own commit
steps.done_when: `archiveIn` copies each archived project's README to `closeout/<name>.md` and rewrites the links under `docs/project/` and `docs/technical/` in the archive commit; the new assertions in `tests/mc/archive-live.test.js` pass; `docs/project/README.md`, `docs/technical/mc-run.md` and `docs/technical/mc-tidy.md` say so; `mc gate` is green.
comments: archiveIn copies each archived project's README to closeout/<project>.md in the archive commit (read before git rm; kept READMEs stay), then relinks every .md under docs/project and docs/technical that points into an archived directory via rewriteArchivedLinks, using git ls-files for the list. closeoutBackfill and writeCloseout are unchanged. Verified: archive-live asserts the closeout README, the relinked technical doc and the untouched external link; mc gate green on the whole tree (2743 tests, 0 failed).
